svg.text: Figure 5 - Address map (STREAM mode, N_STACK = 4, ECC on)
The field ORDER is the whole design. Each goal - spread across stacks, spread across pseudo-channels, hit the open row - owns a different stride.
col = rem20 mod 30 (0..29, 2 columns reserved for ECC)
rem20 sits at the TOP of the address, so reserving 2 of 32 columns
leaves the usable space contiguous: 0 .. 240 GB, no holes.
128 B of address touches all 4 stacks
this is why back-to-back commands never hit tCCD_L
32 banks open at once per PC
